reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound: MTPs are known to capture many-body interactions better than EAM, and training on high-temperature ab initio data from relevant systems should improve phase-space overlap, though the claimed 25–40% reduction and 5 meV/atom threshold are speculative without preliminary evidence.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and decisive: comparing MTP-based free energies to full ab initio results with a quantitative falsification criterion (5 meV/atom or <25% improvement) is feasible, though the computational cost of the ab initio benchmark for a multicomponent HEA liquid is extremely high.
reasons.usefulness: This is a highly useful hypothesis that directly addresses the core methodological gap in TOR-TILD, proposing a concrete, modern alternative (MTP) with a well-defined validation strategy, which would be valuable for researchers in the field.
